data: Does accuracy always increase when the number of pre-training epochs increase?

Wait a moment. The caption states there is no apparent correlation between BLEU and downstream accuracy. Looking at the graph, I can see that while CNN-R (Reconst. BLEU) shows an increasing trend with more pre-training epochs, the CNN-R (Downstream acc.) line fluctuates and does not consistently increase. In fact, it dips slightly around 6 epochs before rising again. This suggests that accuracy does not always increase with more pre-training epochs.
Therefore, the answer is No.
